en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4). Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4).
22.29. Sanidassanattika, Cūḷantaraduka.

A non-visible, non-obstructive, non-conditioned state is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a non-visible, non-obstructive, conditioned state. (Abbreviated. Three in the object; three in the predominance and decisive-support conditions.
Dependent on a non-visible, non-obstructive, non-non-visible state, a visible, obstructive, visible state arises by way of root-condition.
(Abbreviated. Five in the root; five in the predominance … pe … five in the non-disappearance.
A non-visible-non-reacting and non-occult dhamma is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a non-visible-non-reacting and non-occult dhamma.
(Abbreviated. There are three [conditions] in the case of the object; three each in the cases of predominance, decisive support, prenascence, presence, and non-disappearance.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible, non-reacting, and non-opposing, there arises a phenomenon that is visible, reacting, and opposing, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; nine in the case of predominance … pe … three in the case of mutuality … pe … nine in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not without resistance, there arises a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and not without resistance, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; three for predominance … pe … three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and immaterial, there arises a phenomenon that is demonstrable, with resistance, and material, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Twenty-one for root; twenty-one for predominance … pe … mutuality.
Three ... [and so on] ... twenty-one in non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, impinging, and immaterial, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and immaterial by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three in root ... [and so on] ... three in non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, impinging, and not mundane, there arises a state that is visible, impinging, and mundane by way of root condition ... seven.

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not supramundane, a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and supramundane arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance. Dependent on a state that is non-non-demonstrable, with resistance, and mundane, a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and mundane arises by way of root condition; ... seven. Dependent on a visible and impinging mundane state, a [visible and impinging] mundane state arises by way of root condition. ... [Seven. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one;
under predominance condition there are twenty-one ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.

Dependent on a state that is not visible and not impinging and not supramundane, a supramundane state that is not visible and not impinging arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a state that is visible and impinging, but not cognizable by anyone, there arises a state that is visible, impinging, and cognizable by someone, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are thirty-five;
under object condition there are three ... pe ... under mutuality condition there are fifteen ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are thirty-five.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not cognizable by anyone, there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and not cognizable by anyone, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are thirty-five under root;
three under object … pe … fifteen under mutuality … pe … thirty-five under non-disappearance.
